rules.statement: A decree-holder who has been granted an order for credit is not required to make a deposit of 25% of the purchase money under section 260, as sections 272 and 261 must be read in conjunction with section 260.
rules.supporting_quote: "Now section 260, if it be read by itself, clearly places every purchaser under an obligation to make such a deposit, but that section and the sections which follow, sections 261 and 262, must clearly be read in conjunction with section 272 which is in the following terms:..."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 260, 261, 262, 272 of the Civil Procedure Code
